verified_facts.text: The hotel is set between Via Veneto and the gardens of Villa Borghese.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set between Via Veneto and the beautiful gardens of Villa Borghese

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the Via Veneto area, on a hill directly above the historic centre of Rome, with views over the gardens of Villa Borghese.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Hotel Splendide Royal is situated in the Via Veneto area, on a hill directly above the historic centre of Rome with magnificent views out over the green gardens of Villa Borghese.

verified_facts.text: The shops and designer boutiques of Piazza di Spagna and Via dei Condotti are a few steps away.
verified_facts.excerpt: The exclusive shops and designer boutiques of Rome's fashion industry are just a few steps away in the legendary Piazza di Spagna and Via dei Condotti

verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies a restored 19th-century patrician town house.
verified_facts.excerpt: Occupying a finely restored patrician town house, dating back to the 19th century

verified_facts.text: The interiors display antique golden boiseries, rich brocade, polished marble and ornate stucco work.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering a magnificent display of antique golden boiseries, rich brocade, highly polished marble, and ornate stucco work

verified_facts.text: The main lobby has floors of Italian marble, a huge Murano glass chandelier and baroque wall decoration.
verified_facts.excerpt: the floors cobbled with thefinest Italian marble, the huge Murano glass chandelier and the baroque decoration of the walls

verified_facts.text: The baroque-inspired bedrooms and suites have damask drapes, crimson carpets, period furniture, and antique mirrors and artworks in gilded frames.
verified_facts.excerpt: embellished with luxurious damask drapes, plush crimson carpets, period furniture and antique mirrors and artworks housed within impressive gilded frames

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites feature Carrara marble bathrooms, antique furnishings and double-pane glass windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature Carrara marble bathrooms, antique furnishings, elegant fabrics and double-pane glass windows

verified_facts.text: Almost all rooms have large marble bathrooms with natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Almost all rooms have large marble bathrooms with a natural source of light.

verified_facts.text: About one third of the rooms have large walk-out terraces, most facing the Borghese Gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: About one third of the rooms have large walk-out terraces, most of which face the beautiful Borghese Gardens.

verified_facts.text: Some suites have a private terrace overlooking Villa Borghese.
verified_facts.excerpt: some suites have a private terrace overlooking Villa Borghese

verified_facts.text: The gourmet Mirabelle restaurant is on the 7th floor, with a view that takes in almost every monument of ancient Rome.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the 7th floor of the Hotel Splendide Royal, and offering a vista which encompasses almost every monument within the ancient city of Rome, one finds the gourmet "Mirabelle" restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Mirabelle serves Mediterranean cuisine and offers dining on an outside terrace overlooking the gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant features Mediterranean cuisine and offers dining on an outside terrace with a splendid view of the gardens.
There is a bar adjacent to the restaurant

verified_facts.text: Three function rooms seat 10 to 50 participants, and a board room is located in the presidential suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three function rooms, offering maximum comfort and the latest in meeting room technology have a seating capacity for 10 to 50 participants. An additional board room is located in the presidential suite.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a member of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World.
verified_facts.excerpt: one of the members of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from Via Veneto and major works of art by Bernini and Borromini.
verified_facts.excerpt: just steps away from Via Veneto and major works of art by artists the like of Bernini and Borromini
